references.text: Earlier verses in the same account describing Achan's sin and his stoning in the Valley of Achor
The Valley of Achor is mentioned as a boundary marker for the tribe of Judah
Hosea prophesies that the Valley of Achor will become a door of hope for Israel
Isaiah mentions the Valley of Achor as a resting place for livestock in the future restoration
The law that the Lord will turn away from His burning anger when what is devoted to destruction is removed
Stone piles used as memorials and witnesses, similar to the practice of raising stone heaps
Absalom was thrown into a large pit and covered with a great heap of stones, a fate similar to Achan's
